title: {{NAME}} and the Robot Who Needed a Friend
moral: A true hero looks out for those who feel left out.

pages.content: {{NAME}} was a superhero who flew through fairy forests. The fairy forest was full of glowing trees and singing flowers. Tiny fairies zipped from tree to tree, laughing. But at the edge of the forest, a small green robot sat alone. The robot had a sad drooping head. No fairy had stopped to say hello. {{NAME}} flew down to see.

pages.content: {{NAME}} landed next to the robot. The robot said her name was Flick. Flick was sad because the fairies flew away whenever she came close. "I make too much noise," said Flick quietly. Her gears made a soft clunk-clunk sound. {{NAME}}'s eyes were soft and kind. He sat down right next to her. "I like your sound," said {{NAME}}.

pages.content: {{NAME}} had an idea. He used his superhero voice to call out to the fairies. "Come and listen!" he said loudly. The fairies flew over slowly. Flick started to clunk and hum and beep a little song. The fairies stopped. They had never heard a song like this before. They began to dance to the robot music.

pages.content: That night, Flick played a soft sleepy song for everyone. The fairies curled up on the glowing branches. {{NAME}} lay in the soft mossy grass. A true hero looks out for those who feel left out. {{NAME}} felt warm and happy and very sleepy. He closed his eyes slowly. He wondered if Flick knew a song about flying.
